description: This file contains Sass mixins for button styles, including variants, outline styles, and size configurations. It defines reusable style snippets for consistent button styling across the project.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: Defines styles for different button states and variants such as default, hover, focus, active, and disabled.

methods.name: button-outline-variant
methods.description: Defines styles for outline-style button variants with hover and active states.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Defines sizing styles including padding, font size, and border radius for buttons.
